Sarah — attaching an initial MAP and an evaluation test matrix for Clearpath's pilot. High level summary below; full details in attachments (clearpath_map_v1.xlsx, eval_test_cases.md).

Executive summary (condensed):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for triage-assist workflows on a 6-week trial; go/no-go decision at the end of week 6.
- Owners: Clearpath (Product lead), Redwood (Irene = commercial lead, Ben = SRE/ops, Marissa = CS lead).
- Exit gates (must pass all to recommend move to production):
  1) Functional correctness: end-to-end task-level F1 >= 0.86 on the provided holdout set (see test matrix).
  2) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end inference latency <= 350ms for 128-token median requests under the agreed traffic profile.
  3) Reliability: error rate < 0.5% sustained over 24h and < 1% for any 1-hour window during trial.
  4) Cost guardrail: expected per-1k-token cost <= budget target of $1.10 after suggested batching and KV-caching configs.
  5) Security/compliance: data handling checklist completed; SOC2 evidence attached to procurement packet.

Acceptance tests (examples):
- Functional: run evaluation suite on holdout set (eval_test_cases.md). Items are flagged PASS if precision/recall thresholds hit; FAIL otherwise.
- Stress: synthetic burst test at 2x expected QPS for 30 minutes; monitor p99 and errors.
- Degradation: induce 10% node churn (simulated) and ensure <2x latency increase and no data leakage.
- Audit: confirm retention TTLs and that request logs appear in audit pipeline with required fields (user_id, request_id, model_id).

Timeline (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (kickoff): MAP sign-off, credentials, dataset handoff, and baseline run.
- Week 1–2: Integration and smoke tests; functional baseline metrics.
- Week 3–4: Load/stress tests and iteration on models/quantization; cost tuning.
- Week 5: Final acceptance test runs and evidence collection.
- Week 6: Decision review — MAP signoff or rollback plan triggered.

Can you confirm whether the F1 and latency thresholds are acceptable? If so we'll mark this MAP "ready for signature" and share an updated procurement packet for your finance/procurement team.

Attachments: clearpath_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), eval_test_cases.md (test matrix)

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference

Sarah — quick follow-up with operational clarifications and pass/fail measurement details.

Operational notes (from SRE):
- Latency measurement: we will capture end-to-end timing using request_id across client->ingress->model path; p95 will be computed over 5-minute rolling windows.
- Failure modes: any systemic 1-hour window with >1% 5xx rate triggers the rollback runbook.
- Acceptance test tolerance: functional thresholds are target (F1 >= 0.86). For borderline results (0.82–0.86) we will run focused error analysis and one remediation iteration; if still below 0.82 it's a fail.
- Cost estimate: after enabling KV prefix caching and 8-request batching for long-tail flows we estimate steady-state cost ~ $0.98/1k-token (model/quantization profile attached in MAP).

Attachment stubs referenced: eval_test_cases.md (detailed cases), agreement_terms_redlines.pdf (procurement items we'll need to finalize), clearpath_map_v1.xlsx (owners & week-by-week checklist).

Let us know if any of the measurement definitions need to be changed for your internal reporting. If all good, we can add these as line items to the MAP and route for electronic signoff.

-Ben
